aiTables.featureDescription: Models that AI text and AI choice fields can use.
aiTables.promptHelp: Sent to the model for every row. Insert fields to use the row's values.
aiTables.promptPlaceholder: Summarize the description in one sentence
aiTables.fileFieldHelp: The files in this field are sent to the model with the prompt.
aiTables.autoUpdateHelp: Runs as you. It stops if you lose access to the table.
aiTables.autoUpdateLabel: Regenerate when a field in the prompt changes
aiTables.optionsHelp: The model picks one of these for every row.
aiTables.transformDescription: The AI rewrites each selected cell of the columns below. Empty cells are skipped. You can undo it, and the old values stay in each row's history.
aiTables.transformCount: {count} cells will be sent to the model.
aiTables.transformTooMany: {count} cells are selected. At most {max} can be transformed at once, so select fewer rows or columns.
aiTables.transformNotEnabled: No AI model is enabled for AI fields in this workspace. Enable one in the AI providers settings, then try again.
aiTables.transformNotEnabledAskAdmin: No AI model is enabled for AI fields in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin to enable one in the workspace's AI providers settings.
aiTables.instructionHelp: Sent to the model with each cell's text. The answer replaces the cell.
aiTables.instructionPlaceholder: Normalize the name to Title Case
aiTables.transformPartial: {count} rows have a cell that was left as it was: the model failed on it, or it was edited while the model ran.
